content:
A home can become memorable not only because of its size or place, but also because of the story and unique design behind it. One such property is Bob Hope’s unusual Palm Springs residence, widely popular as the actor and singer’s “UFO house.”

Bob Hope's out-of-this-world home eventually discovered a new owner after being offered for a much higher asking price many years earlier.

As per TopTenRealEstateDeals.com, the Palm Springs property sold for $13 million to billionaire Ronald Burkle, a venture capitalist and philanthropist. The home had originally been listed for $50 million in 2013, making the eventual sale price substantially lower than its original asking amount.


The property was positioned on the market 10 years after Hope’s passing in 2003. Hope was 100.



A Home Designed to Resemble a Spaceship

The distinctive property was designed by architect John Lautner for Hope and his wife, Delores, in 1973. At the time, Hope was at the peak of his career.

The architecture offers the property its famous “UFO house” description. The largely curved structure has a futuristic appearance and was made with expansive open spaces and floor-to-ceiling windows.

The home spans around 23,000 square feet, with its windows offering expansive views of Palm Springs. Its unusual design also incorporates circular ceiling windows, giving opportunities for stargazing from inside the residence.

An Expansive Palm Springs Estate

Beyond its striking appearance, the property provides a wide range of amenities. The estate includes six bedrooms and 13 bathrooms, along with indoor and outdoor pools.

The home also has a spa, pond and tennis court.


From $50 Million to $13 Million

The property’s journey to its eventual sale is one of the most significant aspects of the story. Hope’s estate originally positioned the home on the market in 2013 with a $50 million asking price. After attracting no buyers at that price, the residence eventually changed hands for $13 million.

The sale brought a fresh chapter to the unusual Palm Springs property, which had been associated with one of entertainment’s best-known figures and remained unique for its futuristic architecture.

With its spaceship-like appearance, sweeping windows, curved structure and extensive amenities, the estate stands out as an example of an unconventional celebrity home whose architectural character is as memorable as its history.
